reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message: the depot was **Southgate**.

The source is Pree (Priyanka Sundaram), posting in #inc-tansley-carrier-api, a channel Tobias belongs to. On 3 Sep 2025 she wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she closed the incident and said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or site code for Southgate in anything Tobias can see, so I suggested he ask Pree or Hollis if he needs one for the call.
